verses.text: “How you have helped the one without power! You have saved the arm [with] no strength!

verses.text: How you have advised one without wisdom, and have made known insight in abundance!

verses.text: The dead are writhing, underneath the waters and those inhabiting them.

verses.text: Naked [is] Sheol before Him, and there is no covering to Abaddon.

verses.text: He stretches out Zaphon over the void, hanging the earth on nothing whatsoever.

verses.text: Binding the waters in His thick clouds, and the clouds are not broken apart under them,

verses.text: He covers the face of the throne, [and] spreads over it His cloud.

verses.text: He has circled a limit upon the face of the waters, to [be] the boundary of light with darkness.

verses.text: The pillars of the heavens tremble and are astonished at his rebuke.

verses.text: By His strength He stirred the Sea, and by His understanding He shattered Rahab.

verses.text: By His breath the heavens were made clear; His hand pierced the fleeing serpent.

verses.text: Behold, these are the edges of His ways, and how faint of a word do we hear of Him! And the thundering of His might, who can understand?”
